limits: Only the selected public scalar function is covered.
Acyclic v1-v7 scalar Core; calls, resources and floating point are outside this primitive profile.
All stages use one proof deadline, including admission, encoding, search, replay and identity closure; this is not a hard process timeout.
Exact native code bytes and all externally loaded objects need separate custody and lifetime validation.
A consumer must recompute fresh proof results at the point of use.
proof.proved_meaning: The identified native HIA checker established only the stated property for the exact Core subject within this scalar profile. Implementation soundness, whole-language safety and execution authority are not established.

property.statement: For every well-typed argument tuple, the selected before and after functions have the same return values or the same first specified Core trap code.

assumptions.statement: Every quantified argument has the selected freshly verified Core signature.
The primitive v1-v7 scalar semantics, first-trap ordering and declared profile define observations.
The native HIA verifier, graph projection, solver, and independent Core interpreter are trusted implementations, not machine-proved.
The actual embedded native closure is read-only, hashed before and after checking, and executes without hostile process or hardware modification.
Consumers rebind exact inputs and recompute; a serialized receipt grants no execution authority.

unproved_obligations.statement: Programs and constructs outside this selected scalar profile are not covered.
Other public exports require independent checks.
Compilation and actual machine-code refinement require separate validation.
ABI, FFI, image custody, mapping and lifetime require separate validation.
Physical resource, instruction, wall-time, energy and performance bounds are not proved.
Concurrency, signals, faults, side channels and hostile process modification are outside the proof.
Equivalence may preserve a trap and does not imply normal return for every input.
